result.title: Improving Diffusion-Based Augmentation for Data-Scarce Image Classification via Mask-Guided Reference Attention and Repulsive Noise Optimization
result.summary: Diffusion-based data augmentation has emerged as a powerful strategy for addressing data-scarce image classification. Recent pipelines typically adapt a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model to a limited number of class examples and subsequently sample synthetic images using diverse textual prompts. However, in extreme data-scarce regimes such as long-tailed single-sample settings, this approach suffers from a dual failure mode: the generated samples often lack discriminative foreground details crucial for classifier training, and the adapted class prior can bias the early denoising process, causing output images to exhibit similar patterns despite varying text prompts. To overcome these limitations, we propose a sampling-side framework of two complementary components that simultaneously enhance fine details and diversity. First, Mask-Guided Reference (MGR) Attention updates only foreground value tokens with reference features via zero-shot segmentation, limiting reference influence to the target object and mitigating excessive global feature injection. Second, Repulsive Noise Optimization (RNO) encourages initial noise trajectories to diverge from dominant generative modes of the adapted model, enabling target prompts to express broader contextual variation. Extensive evaluations show consistent improvements, with the largest gains in long-tailed single-sample settings of up to 2.50 and 2.94 points on CUB-LT IF100, and further robustness across few-shot and background-shift evaluations.

AI.brief_summary: 针对长尾单样本等极端数据稀缺场景下扩散数据增强的双重失效，提出采样端框架：用零样本分割得到的 Mask-Guided Reference Attention 仅更新前景 value token，并以 Repulsive Noise Optimization 使初始噪声轨迹偏离主导生成模式，以提升细节与多样性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「只用参考特征替换前景 value token」的空间受限特征注入与噪声轨迹分散采样，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的选择性注入及 latent 采样多样性提供方法线索，但原文目标是分类增强而非推理状态，联系需核查。
